module_summary: src/filer.c is the classic uLE device layer behind both the classic browser and the dashboard: global browser/clipboard/paste state, root memory-card presence polling, USB/ATA/MX4SIO/iLink/PC-card readiness waits, genFixPath (uLE path to driver path, HDD/DVRP partition mounting), one directory reader per device (readMC, readXFROM, readCD, readVMC, readHDD, readHDDDVRP, readGENERIC, readHOST, readUDPFS, readSMB) dispatched by listDir, getDir/getDirComplete, and setFileList which builds the root device list and the MISC pseudo-folder. It ends with small read-only accessors for the dashboard. include/filer_actions.h declares the file actions implemented in src/filer_actions.c (size, timestamps, title.cfg, exploit protection, delete/rename/mkdir) and the optional dashboard timestamp UI hooks.

reusable_helpers.name: readGENERICWithFirstOpenRetry
reusable_helpers.what: lists a fileXio folder and, if empty, polls Dopen with 100 ms backoff for a time budget until a freshly loaded BDM device mounts

reusable_helpers.name: readGENERIC
reusable_helpers.what: lists a fileXio folder into FILEINFO entries (skips . and .., fills mc-style attributes, sizes, dates)

reusable_helpers.name: readNetDir
reusable_helpers.what: network folder listing that returns open/read errors instead of a partial list

reusable_helpers.name: mapUsbPathToFatFsPath
reusable_helpers.what: maps usb:/usbN: alias paths to the BDM usbN:/massN: driver path

reusable_helpers.name: genFixPath
reusable_helpers.what: converts a uLE path to the driver path, loading drivers and mounting HDD/DVRP partitions

reusable_helpers.name: makeHostPath
reusable_helpers.what: host: path to backslash form, udpfs passthrough

reusable_helpers.name: makeFslPath
reusable_helpers.what: converts backslashes to forward slashes in a path copy

reusable_helpers.name: clipReserve
reusable_helpers.what: grows the clipboard FILEINFO array with realloc

findings.title: DVRP partition list and folder reader are copies of the HDD versions (setDVRPPartyList, readHDDDVRP)
findings.problem: setDVRPPartyList (834-876) repeats the Dopen/Dread partition loop of setPartyListForDevice (737-772) line for line except the target array and counter. The Dopen/Dread/fill loop of readHDDDVRP (1281-1316) is identical to readHDD (1210-1246) apart from one comment line; both start after mounting the partition and fill info the same way.
findings.fix: Give setPartyListForDevice's loop a static helper that takes the device name, the parties array and the count pointer, and call it for hdd0/hdd1 and dvr_hdd0. Move the Dopen..return i part of readHDD into a static helper taking the mounted dir and call it from both readHDD and readHDDDVRP.
findings.justification: Two helpers replace four near-identical blocks; the DVRP copies are compiled into the shipped ELF (DVRP is on, ps2.yaml:619), so this is a net source reduction of about 60 lines.
findings.benefit: ~60 source lines removed (two 36-line copies and two ~30-line copies collapse to one each, plus helper headers); ELF effect INFERRED small (a few hundred bytes of .text).
findings.evidence: Read filer.c 726-876 and 1171-1321 side by side; the only differences are hddParties[unit]/hddNparties[unit] vs dvrParties/ndvrpparties, device name, and the comment at 1215. Duplicate-block leads 1210-1244==1281-1314 and 742-765==846-868 confirm. tests/test_listing_complete.py stubs setPartyListForDevice and setDVRPPartyList (lines 169, 204) and extracts readers from filer.c, so the test text needs an update.

findings.title: LIBCDVD_LEGACY readCD path and include/snippets/readCD.h are never compiled
findings.problem: No build defines LIBCDVD_LEGACY (ps2.yaml defines LIBCDVD_LATEST at 617; configure_ds34.py adds no CDVD define), so the #else branch at filer.c:656-658 that includes include/snippets/readCD.h (51 lines, the old CDVD_GetDir reader) is never built. snippets/readCD.h has no other includer.
findings.fix: Delete the #ifndef/#else/#include/#endif lines around readCD in filer.c, delete include/snippets/readCD.h, and drop the LIBCDVD_LEGACY branches in launchelf.h:66-68 and cdvd_macro.h:4-9.
findings.benefit: ~62 source lines and one header file removed; no ELF change (the code is never compiled).
findings.evidence: Grep LIBCDVD over ps2.yaml and scripts/configure_ds34.py: only ps2.yaml:617 LIBCDVD_LATEST. Grep LIBCDVD_LEGACY over the repo: filer.c:604, include/launchelf.h:66, include/cdvd_macro.h:4, include/snippets/readCD.h:1-2. Grep 'snippets' over the repo: only filer.c:657. Read readCD.h 1-52 and cdvd_macro.h 1-17.

findings.title: Non-EXFAT #else branches in filer.c are dead: EXFAT is always defined
findings.problem: ps2.yaml:629 defines EXFAT for the only EE target and configure_ds34.py keeps the define list, so every #else (non-EXFAT, old mass: driver) branch in filer.c is never compiled: the mass:/massN: mapping at 301-305, the old mass path patch at 994-998, the mass0:/ probe path at 1338-1339 and 1377-1378, the old mass listing at 1970-1975 and the ATA fallback at 2010-2011.
findings.fix: Delete the #else bodies and the surrounding #ifdef EXFAT/#endif lines in filer.c, keeping the EXFAT code unconditional. The same macro is tested at about 60 other sites (init.c 28, dash_devices.c 8, ...) that can be cleaned the same way.
findings.benefit: ~40 source lines removed from filer.c (about 20 dead body lines plus 20 directive lines); no ELF change.
findings.evidence: grep -n EXFAT ps2.yaml scripts/configure_ds34.py: ps2.yaml:8 (comment) and :629 (define list of wLaunchELF); no removal in configure_ds34.py. git grep -c EXFAT src include: filer.c 10 sites, init.c 28, dash_devices.c 8 and others. Read every cited #ifdef EXFAT/#else block in filer.c.

findings.title: listDir ATA branch hand-rolls the retry loop that readGENERICWithFirstOpenRetry already implements
findings.problem: The ATA case of listDir (1994-2043) reads once, then polls fileXioDopen with a 100 ms busy backoff for 2000 ms (root) or 750 ms and re-reads, stopping on entries or on a non-root path. readGENERICWithFirstOpenRetry (345-381), already used for usb, mass, ilink and cf, does the same loop with the same root test semantics.
findings.fix: Replace the ATA body with loadAtaModules(), canonicalizeAtaPath() and n = readGENERICWithFirstOpenRetry(read_path, info, max, root ? 2000 : 750) (or a flat 2000 as the other BDM devices use).
findings.benefit: ~40 source lines removed; a few hundred bytes of .text INFERRED.
findings.evidence: Read filer.c 345-381 and 1994-2043. Differences: the helper returns at once for a non-root folder that opens but is empty (the ATA loop re-reads it once), and the helper checks isPcCardCfPath, which is false for ata paths. isSimpleDeviceRootPath matches the ATA root test for canonical ataN:/ paths. The MX4SIO branch 2069-2189 is a larger variant with alternate path forms and is not included.

findings.title: Commented-out CodeBreaker partition filter, two copies
findings.problem: The same 16-17 line block of commented-out code (a CodeBreaker .PCB and __ partition name filter) sits in setPartyListForDevice and in setDVRPPartyList. It has been disabled since the uLE era and nothing refers to it.
findings.benefit: 33 source lines removed; no ELF change.
findings.evidence: Read filer.c 745-761 and 849-864: both are /* ... */ comments around identical code.

findings.title: Write-only or constant state in filer.c: mcfreeSpace, host_ready, host_use_Bsl, root_mc_poll_format, readHOST Win_path stores
findings.problem: mcfreeSpace is defined and declared extern but never used. host_ready is only ever assigned (1708, 1736), never read. host_use_Bsl is initialised to 1 and never written, so the branch at 1660-1661 is unreachable. root_mc_poll_format only receives mcGetInfo's format output and is never read. In readHOST, host_path is copied from Win_path (1811) only to build Win_path again per entry (1818), and that Win_path is never read.
findings.fix: Delete mcfreeSpace and its extern; delete host_ready, its two writes and extern; delete host_use_Bsl, its extern and the always-false early return; pass NULL as the format argument at 1570 and delete root_mc_poll_format; delete the two dead stores in readHOST.
findings.benefit: ~12 source lines; mcfreeSpace is 4 bytes of .bss still in the ELF (MEASURED: BUILD-EVIDENCE.md section 5, objects lack -fdata-sections); the rest INFERRED a few dozen bytes of .text/.bss.
findings.evidence: git grep -nw over src include: mcfreeSpace only filer.c:113 and filer_shared.h:54 (tests/test_r3z_browser_wins.py:29 asserts a string is absent, needs no variable); host_ready only filer.c:197,1708,1736 and filer_internal.h:13; host_use_Bsl only filer.c:200,1660 and filer_internal.h:14; root_mc_poll_format only filer.c:269,1570 (mcGetInfo takes NULL outputs, as at filer.c:415). evidence/Launchstation/raw/xref/wLaunchELF-xref-candidates.tsv lists mcfreeSpace with 0 relocations. Read readHOST 1740-1843.

findings.title: setPartyList has no caller
findings.problem: setPartyList only forwards to setPartyListForDevice("hdd0:") and nothing calls it; every user calls setPartyListForDevice directly.
findings.benefit: 5 source lines; no ELF change: the 32-byte section is already discarded by --gc-sections (MEASURED: raw/experiment-fdata/link/wLaunchELF-gc-discarded-first-party.tsv).
findings.evidence: Grep setPartyList over the whole repo: only the definition filer.c:775; all other hits are setPartyListForDevice (filer.c:777, 830, 1066, 1189; test stubs). No header prototype. xref TSV: setPartyList 0 relocations.

findings.title: FILEOP_TRACE definition block in filer.c is unused there
findings.problem: filer.c defines FILEOP_TRACE from ULE_DEBUG_BUILD but never tests it (no #if FILEOP_TRACE in filer.c). The same 8-line block is pasted in filer_copy.c, filer_mount.c and filer_fileops.c, and no build defines ULE_DEBUG_BUILD, so FILEOP_TRACE is 0 in every build.
findings.fix: Delete the block in filer.c. Optionally keep a single copy of the block in a header the other three files already share instead of three pasted copies.
findings.benefit: 8 lines removed from filer.c (up to 24 more if the other copies are merged); no ELF change.
findings.evidence: Grep FILEOP_TRACE over src include: in filer.c only the definition lines 157-162; uses exist only in filer_copy.c, filer_mount.c, filer_fileops.c. Grep ULE_DEBUG_BUILD in ps2.yaml, scripts, workflows: none (brief section 2 agrees).

findings.title: Stale banner comments in filer.c describe code that moved or never existed
findings.problem: 383-403 holds a commented-out debug buffer, an #ifdef DVRP block containing only comment rules, and an unmountAll description ending in 'ends unmountAll' although unmountAll lives in filer_mount.c:155. 889-903 lists gen* functions (including a nonexistent genInit) and says 'endfunc genLimObjName', which is in filer_fileops.c:186. 1581-1582 says 'endfunc addRootUsbDeviceEntries' after pollRootMemoryCardDevices. 2490-2494 says 'End of file: filer.c' with 85 lines of code after it. 48-52 are blank.
findings.benefit: ~45 source lines of misleading comments removed; no ELF change.
findings.evidence: Grep unmountAll definition: src/filer_mount.c:155; genLimObjName definition: src/filer_fileops.c:186; genInit: no definition anywhere (only the comment at filer.c:896). Read the cited ranges.

findings.title: readMC and readXFROM end with the same entry-copy loop
findings.problem: After their GetDir call both readers run the same 16 lines: map a negative result to dirOpenResult, then copy mcDir entries into info skipping . and .. up to max. They already share the static mcDir table (488).
findings.fix: Move the 16 lines into one static function taking ret, info and max, and return it from both readers.
findings.justification: Removes one of two identical 16-line blocks; the helper is about 16 lines, so the net saving is about 12 lines and one place to fix the shared table logic.
findings.benefit: ~12 source lines net; ELF INFERRED neutral to ~100 bytes.
findings.evidence: Read filer.c 490-599; duplicate-block lead 527-542==583-598 (12 normalised lines) matches.

findings.title: canonicalizeAtaPath and canonicalizePcCardCfPath differ only in the prefix
findings.problem: Both functions map 'pfx:' to 'pfx0:...' and 'pfxN:' to 'pfxN:/' with identical structure; only the prefix 'ata'/'cf' and its length differ.
findings.fix: Merge into one static function taking the prefix (length from strlen), with the two call sites (1012, 1021, 2006, 2211) passing "ata" or "cf".
findings.justification: Replaces two 16-line twins with one; net saving about 14 lines.
findings.benefit: ~14 source lines net; no measurable ELF change (INFERRED).

findings.title: No-op indirections: scan_USB_mass forwarder and makeHostPath UDPFS goto to the next line
findings.problem: scan_USB_mass only calls scanUsbMassDevices(0); its three callers are all in filer.c (1974, 1989, 2278) and no header declares it. In makeHostPath the UDPFS block jumps with goto to the label on the following line, which is reached anyway.
findings.fix: Delete scan_USB_mass and call scanUsbMassDevices(0) at its three call sites. Delete the #ifdef UDPFS goto block and the copy_passthrough label.
findings.benefit: ~11 source lines; no ELF change (scan_USB_mass is already inlined and its 28-byte copy discarded, MEASURED in wLaunchELF-gc-discarded-first-party.tsv).
findings.evidence: Grep scan_USB_mass over the repo: definition filer.c:1402, comment 1407, calls 1974, 1989, 2278; no prototype in include/. Read makeHostPath 1647-1679.

findings.title: Functions used only in their own file are exported (filer.c readers, filer_actions.h timestamp helpers)
findings.problem: readMC, readXFROM, readCD, readVMC, readHDD, readHDDDVRP, readGENERIC, readHOST, readUDPFS, readSMB and setDVRPPartyList are non-static but used only in filer.c; readSMB is still declared in filer_shared.h. filer.c also re-declares dashWorkerOnThread locally (222) although dash_internal.h:997 declares it. filerCanSetCustomTimestamp and time_manip_custom are declared in filer_actions.h but used only inside filer_actions.c.
findings.fix: Make these functions static, delete the readSMB prototype from filer_shared.h and the two declarations from filer_actions.h; turn the readGENERIC forward declaration into a static one.
findings.benefit: ~4 header/prototype lines; lets the compiler inline single-call readers (ELF effect not measured).
findings.evidence: git grep -nw for each reader name over src include: no user outside filer.c (readSMB also filer_shared.h:105). raw/xref/wLaunchELF-xref-candidates.tsv marks all eleven 'used only in own object'. Grep filerCanSetCustomTimestamp/time_manip_custom: only filer_actions.h and filer_actions.c. Tests that extract these by text ('int readGENERIC(...)', 'int filerCanSetCustomTimestamp(') still match with a static prefix.
